assets.portrait_crop_edit_prompt: Edit the attached original illustrated Angkor Runner background ONLY. Preserve the centered straight running road, one-point perspective, exact camera, horizon, painterly warm lighting, trees, water, overall 4:3 composition and clear central gameplay lanes. Move the DISTANT Angkor Wat five-tower silhouette and its moat slightly RIGHT within the LEFT midground, about 12% of the canvas width, so the full temple silhouette fits inside the central portrait crop (middle 65% of image width) on phones. It must still be clearly across the water and to the LEFT of the running road, never on the road, with natural trees/shoreline filling the original spot. Keep architecture respectful and recognizably Angkor Wat, stylized rather than exact reconstruction. No new objects, people, text, flags or UI. The road center must remain exactly at image center, x=50%, with unobstructed path.

The riverside scene is a Siem Reap-inspired composite, not a photograph or a claim about a particular street or riverbank.
